messages:
elaine: uploaded a quick Figma of the inline help for autoscale and the pool-swap warning — can we review? https://figma.com/file/xyz

tom: saw it, nice. main concern: the warning text reads a bit alarmist. users might interpret "active jobs will be dropped" as permanent loss.

priya: +1. accessibility note: contrast on the warning pill is borderline (AA fail on 14px). also keyboard focus order needs checking — the dismiss button comes before the help link.

devon: the swap path can preempt running inferences for up to 30s while we rebind the pool. we do background retry in the runtime, but UX should surface expected downtime & auto-retry clearly.

elaine: good catch. current copy draft: "Switching GPU pools may interrupt in-flight requests. Some requests might be retried automatically." any wording ideas that are clearer & calmer?

tom: how about: "Switching pools may pause in-flight requests briefly (typically < 30s). The system will automatically retry most interrupted requests." less scary.

priya: tweak for screen readers: add a short aria-live announcement: "Pool switch initiated — requests may be retried." also make the <30s part optional for SR users, since numbers can be confusing.

devon: we should also call out cost delta if user moves to a different pool tier — maybe a small forecast: "Estimated cost change: +12%" fetched from pricing service.

elaine: love the cost forecast. visual idea: inline microcopy under pool selector: "Estimated cost: +12% · Expected delay: ~20s" and a tiny info icon linking to full explanation.

tom: microcopy options for the info modal (short list):
```
Option A: Switching pools reallocates capacity. In-flight requests may be retried automatically. Expected pause: ~20s.
Option B: Pool change may briefly interrupt requests. We retry most requests; review retry policy in docs.
```

priya: prefer Option A but change "paused" to "paused or retried" for accuracy. Also ensure the info icon has aria-label="Pool change details".

devon: operational note: if autoscale triggers at the same time as a manual pool swap, we can end up with temporary overcommit. Suggest we surface a small guardrail banner: "Autoscale actions paused during pool swap".

elaine: hm, that banner could be noisy. maybe only show when a conflicting event is detected. otherwise show an inline hint: "Autoscale will be suspended until pool swap completes" with a link to rollback.

tom: keyboard flow: when the modal opens, focus should land on primary confirm, not the cancel. current prototype focuses the close X which is bad for keyboard users.

priya: yep. and add visible focus state for the small info icon — it's currently only hover-styled.

ux-bot: accessibility check (auto-lint): warning: color-contrast 14px WCAG AA fail on .warning-pill; missing aria-live region for dynamic retry status; info-icon missing accessible name.

elaine: I'll update the Figma: move focus order, change warning color to #b04a00 (tests as AA), update copy to Tom's wording + Priya tweak, and add the cost forecast slot. pushing new frame in 30m.

devon: after that I can wire the cost forecast API hook. one question: do we want estimated delay to be a single value or a range? runtime gives 10–30s depending on KV cache warmup.

tom: range is safer: "Expected delay: ~10–30s" — but Priya's comment about numbers for SR persists. maybe show range visually and have screen reader-friendly phrase: "expected delay between ten and thirty seconds".

priya: agree. final microcopy suggestion for inline line: "Estimated cost: +12% · Expected delay: 10–30s (most requests auto-retry)" and SR version: "Estimated cost increase twelve percent. Expected delay between ten and thirty seconds. Most requests are retried automatically."

elaine: perfect. will upload the iteration as 2099990018 when done. thanks everyone :rocket:
